title: Boiler temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: PT100 or thermocouple reading out of range.
fullDescription:
E01 on Rancilio commercial-style machines indicates the temperature probe is open-circuit, shorted, or disconnected. Common on Silvia Pro and Epoca with PID controllers.

Disconnect the probe, measure resistance, and replace if open.

title: Heating timeout / element failure
shortDescription: Boiler did not reach setpoint within allowed time.
fullDescription: E02 indicates slow or no heating. Causes: scaled element, blown thermal fuse, or open heater.

title: Pressure transducer fault
fullDescription: E03 occurs when the brew pressure transducer signal is out of range, common on Silvia Pro X with PID and pressure display.

title: Steam boiler over-temperature
fullDescription: E04 trips when the steam boiler exceeds its safety setpoint, typically due to scale or stuck triac.

title: Water level / autofill fault
fullDescription: On Epoca and Silvia Pro the autofill probe in the boiler can scale over and stop conducting. E05 fires when water cannot be confirmed.

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean probe
fixSteps.instruction: Drain boiler, remove probe, scrape scale.

title: Steam boiler heating timeout
shortDescription: Steam boiler did not heat in time.
fullDescription: E06 indicates steam boiler heating failure - similar root causes to E02 but for the secondary boiler on dual-boiler models.

title: Pump pressure too low
shortDescription: Vibratory pump or rotary pump not building pressure.
fullDescription: E07 indicates pressure below expected during brew - failed pump, clogged inlet, or air lock.

fixSteps.title: Prime pump
fixSteps.instruction: Open steam valve to bleed air.

title: Tank low / level switch trip
fullDescription: Reservoir reed switch trips when water is low. False trips occur when the float magnet is missing.

faq.a: Possible on Pro X with kit.

title: PID controller fault
fullDescription: E08 indicates an internal PID controller fault. Power cycle resolves transient cases; persistent fault means board replacement.

title: Brew solenoid fault
fullDescription: E09 indicates the brew solenoid coil failed or the position feedback is wrong. Solenoid may need replacement.

fixSteps.title: Tap solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Light tap to free stuck plunger.

fixSteps.title: Replace solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect plumbing, swap coil and body.
